title: 第一卷 第3章 胆小鬼，闫耀宗？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

回到上闫村。

闫耀宗思前想后，还是决定再找个帮手。

那头野猪起码两百来斤，现在陷在泥潭里边，单靠他一个人……是真拉不出啊。

“砰砰砰！”

闫耀宗抬手狠狠地拍打着屋门。

“来了来了！”

随着屋内的声音响起，屋门被慢慢

“耀宗？”闫振东看着光着脚，全身被淋透的闫耀宗，不由得嘴角一抽，道：“借粮食？我家里也不多了，最多借你五斤。你先在门口蹲一会儿，等我爹娘去内屋，我再给你去拿。”

听完闫振东的话，闫耀宗心中一暖，笑着摆摆手，道：“我不是来借粮食的。”

“那你来找我是？”闫振东面露疑惑，这么大雨，总不可能找他来玩的吧？

“我在溪山的山溪附近，看到一头陷进泥潭的野猪，起码有两百斤。你拿条麻绳，咱们现在去把它拉出来！”闫耀宗道。

闫振东眼睛一亮，道：“你确定没看错？”

“我又不眼瞎，赶紧的，要是被别人弄走……”

“你等我！”

没等闫耀宗把话说完，闫振东扭头就向着柴房跑去。

只见闫振东将一捆麻绳套在胳膊上，手里边提着两把柴刀。

“走！”闫振东将一把柴刀递给闫耀宗，便大步向着屋外跑去。

“你个小兔崽子，这么大雨，你要死哪里去？”

屋内响起闫振东他爹的咒骂。

闫振东纯当没听到。

俩人都没有穿蓑衣，就这么淋着雨，光着脚，向着溪山跑去。

二十多分钟后。

俩人来到泥潭附近。

看着被油布裹着的野猪，闫振东扭头看向闫耀宗，竖起大拇指，咧嘴笑道，“耀宗，我不要多。我只要一条猪后腿跟猪头。嘿嘿，等会村里，我补给你五斤大米。”

“先把野猪拉出来再说！”闫耀宗道。

“行！”

闫振东肩膀一抖，麻绳滑到手里。

快速打了个套，闫振东抬手抹掉脸上的雨水，眯着眼，瞄准野猪的后腿。

用力一抛。

绳套稳稳地落在野猪后腿。

“快快快！”闫振东迫不及待的看向闫耀宗，“快使劲！”

第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Return to Shangyan Village.

Yan Yaozong thought about it and decided to find another helper.

That wild boar weighs at least two hundred pounds and is now stuck in the quagmire. He can't pull it out alone...

"Bang bang bang!"

Yan Yaozong raised his hand and slapped the door hard.

"Coming, coming!"

As the sound inside the house rang, the door was slowly opened

"Yao Zong?" Yan Zhendong looked at Yan Yaozong, who was barefoot and soaked to the skin, and couldn't help but twitching the corner of his mouth and said, "Borrow food? I don't have much at home, so I can lend you five kilograms at most. You squat at the door for a while, and when my parents go to the inner room, I will get it for you."

After listening to Yan Zhendong's words, Yan Yaozong felt warm in his heart, smiled, waved his hands and said, "I'm not here to borrow food."

"Then why did you come to see me?" Yan Zhendong looked confused. It was raining so hard. It was impossible to come to him to play, right?

"I saw a wild boar stuck in the mire near the mountain stream in Xishan. It weighs at least two hundred kilograms. Get a hemp rope and let's pull it out now!" Yan Yaozong said.

Yan Zhendong's eyes lit up and he said, "Are you sure you read it correctly?"

"I'm not blind, hurry up, if someone else takes you away..."

"Wait for me!"

Before Yan Yaozong could finish speaking, Yan Zhendong turned around and ran towards the woodshed.

Yan Zhendong was seen putting a bundle of hemp rope on his arm and holding two hatchets in his hand.

"Let's go!" Yan Zhendong handed a hatchet to Yan Yaozong and ran out of the house in large strides.

"You little brat, where are you going to die if it rains so heavily?"

Yan Zhendong's father's curses sounded in the house.

Yan Zhendong pretended not to hear.

Neither of them wore raincoats, so they ran towards Xishan with bare feet in the rain.

More than twenty minutes later.

The two came to a quagmire.

Looking at the wild boar wrapped in oilcloth, Yan Zhendong turned to look at Yan Yaozong, gave a thumbs up, and grinned, "Yao Zong, I don't want more. I just want a pig's hind legs and a pig's head. Hey, I'll give you five kilograms of rice in the village later."

"Pull the wild boar out first!" Yan Yaozong said.

"Okay!"

Yan Zhendong's shoulders shook, and the hemp rope slipped into his hand.

After quickly throwing a trap, Yan Zhendong raised his hand to wipe the rain off his face, squinted and aimed at the wild boar's hind legs.

Throw it hard.

The noose fell firmly on the wild boar's hind legs.

"Quick, quick, quick!" Yan Zhendong looked at Yan Yaozong impatiently, "Hurry up!"
